articles.headline: Fantasy baseball news: Boston looking to clinch, Tucker and Dodgers trying to stay healthy
articles.description: All of the important fantasy spin and actionable takeaways resulting from the latest baseball news.
articles.body:
Everything that happens in and around MLB has some additional context when viewed from a fantasy baseball perspective. From lineup changes to minor league call-ups to injuries and so much more, the news cycle will constantly affect player values in fantasy baseball.

Our fantasy baseball buzz file, with contributions from our ESPN fantasy writers, aims to provide fantasy managers with the intel they need as news breaks around MLB.

Key links:  RP depth chart | Player Rater | Scoring leaders 

10-day pitching forecaster | 10-day hitting forecaster

Sept. 20: Sunday's news to know

By Todd Zola

The penultimate Sunday of the regular season gets going at 1:10 p.m. ET with the New York Mets hosting the Philadelphia Phillies. This is one of a few contests that may have to deal with rain. Both clubs have Monday off, howver, if conditions prohibit playing the game and there's a need to reschedule. 

Other matchups under any kind of "weather watch" include the Pittsburgh Pirates at the Kansas City Royals, the Athletics at the Cleveland Guardians and the Detroit Tigers at the Chicago White Sox. Fortunately, none of these six teams are slated to play on Monday either, so the same "wiggle room" applies.

The Boston Red Sox are rearranging their rotation to line up for their likely wild-card series. This pushes Payton Tolle to Tuesday, with Patrick Sandoval taking the hill this afternoon in the rubber game against the Tampa Bay Rays.  

Bryce Eldridge is in the league's concussion protocol and will miss today's NL West matchup between the San Francisco Giants and Los Angeles Dodgers. He reportedly bumped his head at the team hotel. Brett Harris will likely fill in at first base.

Kyle Tucker left yesterday's contest in the seventh inning after fouling a ball off his leg. The Dodgers were ahead by six runs at the time and manager Dave Roberts indicated that the score helped in the decision. He's hopeful that the outfielder will play today. It's been a frustrating year for Tucker, but he's doing his best to salvage the season with a .327/.424/.796 line over his last 15 games.

Be sure to check out the latest fantasy lineup advice as well as the MLB betting tips for Sunday. 

Sept. 19: Saturday's news to know

By Todd Zola

Today's action starts a bit earlier than initially scheduled, with the Windy City doubling as Rainy City. To avoid heavy showers in the early evening, the Chicago White Sox hosting the Detroit Tigers has been moved up to 2:10 p.m. ET. Three more matinees follow in the 4:00 p.m. ET block, leaving 11 evening games.

The Boston Red Sox have not quite yet secured a playoff berth, but they're adjusting their rotation for the impending wild-card round by sending Brayan Bello to the hill today to face the Tampa Bay Rays in St. Petersburg. articles.headline: European soccer live updates: Man City, Liverpool in action
articles.description: The European soccer weekend continues with Man City looking to go clear at the top of the Premier League vs. Sunderland, and Liverpool facing Bournemouth.
articles.body:
The weekend of soccer across Europe continues!

In the Premier League, Liverpool travel to take on AFC Bournemouth while Manchester City, coming off their Manchester derby win, can go three points clear of champions Arsenal at the top of the table with a home win over Sunderland. Later, Manchester United visit Fulham as they look to bounce back after losing the derby and getting eliminated midweek in the Carabao Cup.

In LaLiga, Atlético Madrid host Real Madrid in the first Madrid derby of the season, while Juventus meet Atalanta in Serie A. In the Bundesliga, Bayer Leverkusen face RB Leipzig before the day concludes in Ligue 1 with Marseille hosting Paris Saint-Germain in Le Classique.

Enjoy all the updates from Sunday's matches.

articles.headline: Sources: Colts' Keenan Allen faces minimum 3-game suspension
articles.description: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen, who was formally charged last week with two misdemeanor offenses stemming from his drunk-driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month, is facing a minimum three-game suspension, sources told ESPN.
articles.body:
Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen, who was formally charged last week with two misdemeanor offenses stemming from his drunk driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month, is facing a minimum three-game suspension from the NFL, league sources told ESPN.

Three-game suspensions are mandated by the NFL's collective bargaining agreement, which also stipulates that suspensions could be longer if a player is intoxicated at higher levels.

Police officers on the scene the morning Allen was arrested said they received a .224 blood-alcohol level reading from the veteran wide receiver -- three times the legal limit, meaning the league could decide to increase the three-game ban that he already is facing.

According to a probable cause affidavit obtained by ESPN's Stephen Holder, Allen's blood-alcohol level triggered a more serious Class A misdemeanor charge, per Indiana law.

An Indianapolis police sergeant encountered Allen at 1 a.m. after conducting a traffic investigation. Allen, according to the police report, was parked in a no-parking zone, prompting the officer to address the situation. The officer stated he smelled a strong odor of alcohol when he went to speak to Allen.

Allen is not expected to miss playing time while the case proceeds through the courts. Coach Shane Steichen said Wednesday that the Colts are allowing the legal process to play out.

The NFL is expected to wait for Allen's legal case to conclude before it proceeds with any potential discipline. The next event on the docket in the case, an attorney conference, is scheduled for Oct. 26.

Allen, 34, joined the Colts in August on a one-year deal. The six-time Pro Bowler had six catches for 32 yards in the Colts' Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.

articles.headline: Browns expected to evaluate QB situation ahead of Week 3
articles.description: The Browns are expected to evaluate their QB situation after their Week 2 game against the Buccaneers.
articles.body:
Decision time is coming for the Cleveland Browns and their quarterback situation.

Deshaun Watson will make his second straight start on the road to open the season for the Browns -- and after that, Cleveland will make its evaluation.

While no firm decision has been made for Week 3, the belief is that the first two games would serve as a natural evaluation point. In other words, the Browns could use the return to Cleveland for their Week 3 home opener and a two-game sample size as the impetus for a quarterback change.

Shedeur Sanders would be the next man up.

Watson earned the right to start the first two weeks with his play in camp and his experience. But Cleveland's offensive game operation in Week 1 left those in the building frustrated. And the performance all around -- not just from Watson -- wasn't great in the 34-10 season-opening loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.

The reality is, Watson will help inform the decision moving forward with his play Sunday against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. If Watson plays well and leads Cleveland to a victory, the Browns have an easy decision. If it does not go well for Watson in a loss, a change could be coming.

The middle ground is the area where it's less clear cut.

But the Browns need to come out of this season knowing if they have a franchise quarterback on their roster. With multiple first-round picks in the 2027 draft, Cleveland is among the teams in the mix for one of the top quarterbacks from college.

If it doesn't look like Watson is a major part of their future moving forward, the Browns need to see if Sanders is. The fuller the look, the better.

After last week, when Watson went 16 of 22 for 205 yards with a touchdown and an interception, Browns coach Todd Monken told reporters he anticipated sticking with Watson. Monken later said the game tape confirmed his decision.

Watson did play better in the second half against Jacksonville, and perhaps getting his feet wet after a few years ago will lead to a more consistent performance Sunday.

"We got to play better around him," Monken said. "We got to call it better, and he's got to play better."

articles.headline: How to bet Colts-Chiefs on 'SNF': Analysis, tips and favorite plays
articles.description: Odds, bets and analysis to help you bet Colts-Chiefs on "Sunday Night Football."
articles.body:
The Indianapolis Colts have a problem that goes beyond losing 41-23 to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1. They couldn't get the Ravens off the field. Indianapolis allowed 506 yards and 7.9 yards per play, including 202 rushing yards at 5.5 per carry. Now they go from dealing with Derrick Henry and Lamar Jackson to a Kansas City Chiefs offense that might have finally found the rushing attack it has been missing. Kenneth Walker III ran for 173 yards in his Chiefs debut, helping K.C. pile up 220 rushing yards against Denver.

If Indianapolis has to commit extra bodies to stopping him, that's when Patrick Mahomes gets favorable looks off play-action against a secondary still incorporating new players.

For the Colts, the counter is Jonathan Taylor, who ran for 98 yards and two touchdowns against Baltimore. Indianapolis needs him to keep this game on schedule. The worst-case scenario is falling behind early and putting the game entirely on Daniel Jones, who managed just 166 passing yards in Week 1.

Betting outlook

I am more interested in the total than laying 6.5 with Kansas City. Both offenses have clear ways to attack the opposing defense. Kansas City can lean on its upgraded rushing attack against a Colts front that entered the season with major questions, which should also create favorable opportunities for Mahomes.

Indianapolis can contribute, too. Taylor gives the Colts a way to stay efficient on early downs, while Kansas City's rebuilt secondary is still the vulnerable part of an otherwise strong defense.

That creates opportunities for Alec Pierce vertically, Josh Downs underneath and Tyler Warren over the middle. OC Shane Steichen also matters here. His offenses have consistently been aggressive early in games and efficient in the red zone, so Indianapolis doesn't necessarily need Jones to produce a huge passing day to score.

If the Colts can get into the low-to-mid 20s, Kansas City has enough matchup advantages offensively to push this game over the total.

Notable player props, bets

Note: Odds by DraftKings  and subject to change.

Patrick Mahomes passing yards OVER 220.5 (-113)

Eric Moody: Mahomes finished with just 184 passing yards in week 1 against the Broncos, with only 37 of those going to wide receivers. I expect Kansas City to get its aerial attack going against the Colts. Lamar Jackson threw for 324 yards against Indianapolis in Week 1, and Mahomes threw for 352 against the Colts last season. Mahomes averages 248.4 passing yards per game since 2024, well above this week's line.

Kenneth Walker III rushing yards OVER 80.5 (-111)

Maldonado: The stronger look is sticking with K.C.'s newfound strength. Week 1 showed a potentially meaningful schematic change that fits both Walker's skill set and this matchup. I'm less interested in the 173 rushing yards last week than I am in how he got there.

articles.headline: Who are the top 10 players without a Super Bowl ring?
articles.description: Introducing our Super Bowl Top 10s. First, we rank the best players who never won a championship, beginning with Dan Marino.
articles.headlineJa: スーパーボウルリングを手にしていないトップ10選手は誰か？
articles.descriptionJa: 「スーパーボウル トップ10」企画。第1弾は、ダン・マリーノをはじめとする、一度も世界一に輝いたことがない最高の名選手たちをランキング形式で紹介する。
articles.body:
Every NFL player has the same goal: win a Super Bowl ring.

But football is the ultimate team sport, and with the exception of maybe someone such as Tom Brady, it's hard for one player to will his team over the championship finish line. In the NFL today, active players such as Baltimore Ravens' Calais Campbell (19th season) and New Orleans Saints' Cameron Jordan (16th season) are still chasing a Super Bowl ring. Buffalo Bills quarterback Josh Allen (ninth season) has taken his team to the AFC Championship Game twice in eight tries and ran into Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City Chiefs dynasty both times.

How hard is it to win a Super Bowl? We ranked 10 of the best retired players who played at least half their careers in the Super Bowl era but never won a ring. Some of them made multiple appearances in the big game and came up just short, while others never made it beyond the conference championship. The methodology, which utilized Pro Football reference approximate values, included ESPN analyzing the statistics and intangibles of players in the Super Bowl era who didn't win a ring and put together a list ranking the best of the best.

Here are 10 of the best players in NFL history who finished their careers without a Super Bowl win. Let's start with a Pro Football Hall of Fame quarterback who spent his career with the Miami Dolphins.

COUNTDOWN TO SUPER BOWL LXI: ESPN will televise the Super Bowl for the first time in February. We are counting down to the big game with a Super Bowl Top 10 series -- featuring rankings on everything from best catches and performances to biggest upsets -- that will run every other Sunday leading up to Super Bowl LXI on Feb. 14, 2027.

No. 1: Dan Marino, quarterback

Teams played for: Miami Dolphins (1983-99)

What you might have forgotten: Marino's 1984 season was the gold standard for quarterbacks for years to come. Quarterbacks chased after Marino's single-season record of 5,084 passing yards for more than 20 years before Tom Brady and Drew Brees passed it in 2011. That 1984 season, Marino's second and his first full season as a starter, is still considered one of the best seasons by a quarterback. He led the NFL in passing attempts (564), completions (362), passing touchdowns (48), passing yards (5,084) and rating (108.9), among other records. 

Number of Super Bowls Marino appeared in: 1 (Super Bowl XIX)

Just how close did he come to winning a ring? Marino came into Super Bowl XIX with a 14-2 record as a starter that season and an MVP award. Unfortunately, he had to face the San Francisco 49ers' Joe Montana in his prime. Both quarterbacks passed for more than 300 yards for the first time in the game's history, but Montana's 339 passing yards and 59 rushing yards were too much to overcome in a 38-16 win by the Niners.

articles.headline: Jets WR Garrett Wilson sheds slot, makes move back to outside
articles.description: Wilson hopes to avoid hits and be able to deliver more explosive plays on the perimeter.
articles.headlineJa: ジェッツWRギャレット・ウィルソンがスロットを離れ、再びアウトサイドへポジション復帰
articles.descriptionJa: ウィルソンは激しいタックルを避け、フィールドの外側でより爆発的なプレーを生み出したいと考えている。
articles.body:
FLORHAM PARK, N.J. -- A look at what's happening around the New York Jets:

1. Role shift: Garrett Wilson is back in his comfort zone, back on the perimeter and back in the position where he expects his big-play production to increase.

So long, slot.

Wilson lined up as a slot receiver on only four of 46 offensive plays (9%) in last week's opener, a significant drop from his first four seasons (29%).

This represents a philosophical shift, which began last season, when he mentioned to coach Aaron Glenn that he'd like to be used more often on the outside. Wilson huddled with new offensive coordinator Frank Reich, who was on board.

"I think it just makes sense," Wilson told ESPN. "I ended up catching a lot of passes these past three, four years at 4 yards, 5 yards, and my back's to the defense and I get smacked after. I can do that, and it's cool, but it's just back to my roots for me.

"It's more like playing true receiver, that one-on-one game with the corner. You end up catching more passes down the field, and you're just more away from all the -- I'm not a huge guy. Those guys in the interior, the defense, are big guys. It just gives me more space to operate, which I like a lot. I think that's where I'm my best."

It's not like Wilson struggled in his previous role. In fact, he became only the 10th player in NFL history to record 1,000 receiving yards in each of his first three seasons, and he probably would've done it four straight if it weren't for a knee injury that cost him 10 games last year. The numbers are more impressive when considering he has played with nine different quarterbacks.

But now that he's playing almost exclusively on the outside, in an offense that he enjoys, with a quarterback not afraid to throw deep ... well, he's a very happy camper. He doesn't have to worry about a slot-corner blitz. He doesn't have to block in traffic. He can just do his thing -- "my natural game," he said.

"It's a long season, and we're going to end up doing a lot, but being back outside is definitely refreshing," Wilson said. "It makes that film when I go home a lot more simple. Did you beat that DB? Did you finish the play? How open were you? I'm just able to watch my route, which is kind of cool."

He caught six passes for 79 yards in the opener, including five for 73 on the outside.

2. Statement game: It's the home opener Sunday. The opponent is the Green Bay Packers, a perennial playoff team. It's a chance for the Jets to be 2-0 for the first time since 2015, the league's second-longest active drought. (The Cleveland Browns haven't been 2-0 since 1993.)

It's a chance for Glenn & Co. to change the narrative.

"I think each week, we're trying to make a statement; it doesn't matter who it is," Glenn said. "I think we all know our history, and we're trying to change that history."

That history includes only 11 2-0 starts in the 66 years of the franchise.

articles.headline: What to expect from Patriots QB Drake Maye vs. the Steelers
articles.description: New England wants Maye to be patient but aggressive. Can he have success against the daunting Pittsburgh defense?
articles.headlineJa: スティーラーズ戦におけるペイトリオッツQBドレイク・メイへの期待
articles.descriptionJa: ニューイングランドはメイに我慢強くも積極的であることを求めている。彼は強力なピッツバーグのディフェンスを相手に活躍できるだろうか？
articles.body:
FOXBOROUGH, Mass. -- Quick-hit thoughts and notes around the New England Patriots and NFL:

1. Maye's response: Among quarterback Drake Maye's endearing personality traits is a willingness to peel back the curtain and share core parts of his mindset. One example is how he said the season-opening loss to the Seahawks on Sept. 9 -- in which he threw three interceptions in the fourth quarter -- was tough.

Because the Patriots played on a Wednesday, arrived home early Thursday morning, and players weren't in meetings again until Sunday, it extended Maye's moving-on process.

"You got a lot of time to think about it," he said.

Maye usually gives himself 24 hours when moving on from a performance that didn't meet his personal standard. He said he thinks about it Sunday night, watches the game over Monday, and then you "kind of get rid of it."

It sets up the top storyline for the Patriots entering Sunday's home opener against the Steelers (1 p.m. ET, CBS): How does Maye respond?

By last Monday, he had taken a page from Bill Belichick and told sports radio WEEI, "We're on to Pittsburgh." Teammates took note of Maye's move in that direction.

"I've seen a guy that came back to work. I haven't seen him like he's walking around with his head down or anything like that," said veteran safety Kevin Byard, who is one of six captains along with the 24-year-old Maye.

In doing so, Maye highlighted the "heightened consequences" of when he makes the wrong split-second decisions, such as on each of his three interceptions when he forced plays down the field. Coach Mike Vrabel noted that Maye "can't get bored doing the right thing."

Therein lies the balance Maye aims to strike against a Steelers team that won its opener over the Falcons 20-13 on the strength of its defense, led by T.J. Watt, Cameron Heyward, Jalen Ramsey & Co. He must stay disciplined and patient to take what's there against a Steelers unit that has forced multiple turnovers in nine games since the start of last season (third most in the NFL), but not hesitate to attack down the field when the opportunity presents itself.

Those opportunities down the field should be there based on recent history.

Since the start of the 2025 season, opponents have completed 51% of throws 20-plus yards downfield against the Steelers (ranks 31st in NFL), according to ESPN Research. 

Meanwhile, Maye has completed 50% of passes 20-plus yards down the field since the start of last season, which ranks third among 32 qualified quarterbacks. But Maye was 0-for-3 on those throws in the opener against the Seahawks.

Offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels highlighted how Maye is in a different situation compared to last year because opponents have had a full year to study an entire season of his play in the current offensive system.

articles.headline: Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi wants more from Dominic Solanke: 'Not good enough'
articles.description: Roberto De Zerbi has acknowledged Tottenham Hotspur need more from Dominic Solanke after he criticised the physical condition of the forward.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナムのロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督、ドミニク・ソランケにより多くを要求：「まだ不十分」
articles.descriptionJa: ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督は、FWドミニク・ソランケのコンディション面を批判した上で、トッテナム・ホットスパーには彼からのさらなる貢献が必要だと認めた。
articles.body:
Roberto De Zerbi has acknowledged Tottenham Hotspur need more from Dominic Solanke after he criticised the physical condition of the forward.

Spurs remain winless in the Premier League after five matches following a dismal second-half display in a 3-2 home loss to Aston Villa on Saturday.

England striker Solanke was hauled off after 66 minutes following another anonymous outing -- after a similar showing in a 0-0 draw at Everton earlier this month.

The 29-year-old endured an injury-hit 2025-26 campaign and missed parts of pre-season this summer, but has featured in all seven fixtures this term and only has one goal against Charlton in the Carabao Cup to show for it.

After De Zerbi put his faith in the ex-Bournemouth attacker, the returns so far have been below-par for a player who cost £65 million ($87m) in 2024.

"We need more from him, for sure, but he's one of my players," De Zerbi said.

"I like Dom as a player and I stay with him until the end. He needs to stay better to feel better. The physical condition is not good enough, for sure, but it's normal for him [after an injury].

"Maybe it's not good enough the confidence [in] himself in this moment because he's much better than this Dom Solanke.

"Maybe many, many things can be better than this moment. I think we can't say everything is bad, but it's not enough."

Solanke's terrible start to the campaign is under the microscope due to the eye-catching decision by De Zerbi and Tottenham to leave Richarlison out of the club's 25-player Premier League squad list.

Richarlison could have been included as one of the 17 non-homegrown options instead of long-term absentee Xavi Simons, but De Zerbi claimed the Brazilian "decided everything alone" due to his failure to secure a move away from Spurs in August.

After Richarlison scored 11 league goals last season to help keep Tottenham in the top flight, he was informed that he was not part of the club's first-team plans and could leave, but a transfer to Everton collapsed before deadline day.

- De Zerbi refuses to speak to Tottenham players, calls on 'leaders' to 'lead'

Even though Tottenham ended their league goal drought against Aston Villa with Conor Gallagher and Jan Paul van Hecke on target, their lack of firepower in attack has ensured Richarlison remains the elephant in the room and Mathys Tel was conspicuous by his absence on Saturday.

Tel has endured a difficult start to the new season but was not named on the bench by De Zerbi and it meant Mohammed Kudus and James Maddison were the only out-and-out attacking options for the Italian when his team needed to chase the game.

"Technical decision. He was in the stands because I think during the game, Maddison and Kudus, they had more chances to change the game," De Zerbi said.

articles.body:
Real Madrid striker Endrick could be the subject of a January bid from Premier League champions Arsenal, while Real Sociedad right-back Jon Aramburu is being looked at by Manchester City and Liverpool. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Arsenal are monitoring striker Endrick's situation at Real Madrid with a view to making a move in January, according to TEAMtalk. The 20-year-old Brazil international's first appearance this season came as a late substitute in Tuesday's 3-2 win at Elche, and he is concerned about his role both now and in the long term. There is a growing belief among a number of clubs -- including Liverpool, Manchester City and Manchester United -- that he could be available in 2027. Endrick doesn't want to leave, and Madrid are reluctant to part with a player in whom they have invested heavily, but the situation is complicated because of the amount of competition around him.

- Manchester City and Liverpool are both considering a move for Real Sociedad right-back Jon Aramburu, TEAMtalk reports. The Venezuela international has been one of the defensive stars of the season in LaLiga and his form has attracted interest from a number of clubs across Europe. The 24-year-old has been particularly impressive in one-vs.-one situations while also making an impact further forward, while his ability to play on the left as well as the right makes him an attractive and versatile proposition. Aramburu's contract, which runs until 2030, has a release clause of around £50 million. 

- Liverpool are preparing to receive bids for midfielder Florian Wirtz in January, including from Bayern Munich, though the club are reluctant to part with the 23-year-old, according to AS. Wirtz has struggled to reach his peak form on a consistent basis since arriving from Bayer Leverkusen and is without a goal in his last 12 competitive matches for club and country. As a result, clubs across Europe believe there's a chance they could tempt him away from Anfield, but Liverpool are likely to reject any advances. Reds boss Andoni Iraola still sees the Germany midfielder as a key part of his plans.

- Chelsea fear that defender Josh Acheampong could leave, AS reports. The Blues are alarmed at the amount of interest in the 20-year-old and are worried he could depart in January, despite having been given a starting role for the club, and assurances that he is part of their long-term plans by boss Xabi Alonso. The centre-back has started four games, but has been part of a defence that has conceded two goals or more a game in 2026-27.

- Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham is close to extending his contract at Real Madrid until 2032, according to Nicolò Schira. articles.headline: Michael Carrick: Man United cannot let VAR error have 'impact' on rest of season
articles.description: Michael Carrick has warned his Manchester United players last weekend's VAR controversy in their derby defeat to rivals City cannot become a pivotal moment in their season.
articles.headlineJa: マイケル・キャリック：マンチェスター・ユナイテッドはVARの誤審を残りのシーズンに影響させてはならない
articles.descriptionJa: マイケル・キャリックはマンチェスター・ユナイテッドの選手たちに対し、ライバルのマンチェスター・シティに敗れた先週末のダービーにおけるVARを巡る論争が、今シーズンの重大な分岐点になってはならないと警告しました。

articles.headline: Tottenham's horror start continues with home loss to Villa
articles.description: Aston Villa heap pressure on Roberto De Zerbi's big-spending and still winless Spurs with a 3-2 victory at Tottenham Hotspur stadium.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナムの惨憺たるスタートが継続、ホームでヴィラに敗戦
articles.descriptionJa: アストン・ヴィラがトッテナム・ホットスパー・スタジアムで3-2の勝利を収め、巨額の補強を行いながら未だ勝ちのないロベルト・デ・ゼルビ率いるスパーズに大きなプレッシャーを与えた。

articles.headline: Brighton shatter Arsenal's perfect start
articles.description: Brighton shock Mikel Arteta's dumbstruck side 3-0 to end Arsenal's 100% start to their EPL title defense in stunning fashion.
articles.headlineJa: ブライトンがアーセナルの開幕からの全勝記録を粉砕
articles.descriptionJa: ブライトンが、茫然自失のミケル・アルテタ監督率いるチームを3-0で下す衝撃の勝利。EPLタイトル防衛を目指すアーセナルの開幕からの全勝スタートに終止符を打った。

articles.headline: Sevilla's Luis García: 'It's a joke' Raphinha not Ballon d'Or nominee after another Barcelona hat trick
articles.description: Sevilla coach Luis García said it is a joke Raphinha is not among the Ballon d'Or nominees after watching the Barcelona forward score a hat-trick in his side's 3-1 defeat on Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: セビージャのルイス・ガルシア監督、ハフィーニャの再度のハットトリックに「彼がバロンドール候補にいないのは冗談だ」
articles.descriptionJa: セビージャのルイス・ガルシア監督は、土曜日にチームが1-3で敗れた試合でハットトリックを決めたバルセロナのFWハフィーニャを見て、彼がバロンドール候補に含まれていないのは冗談のようなものだと語った。
